entries.definitionCN: 在英式口语中，「擅长数字」即擅长算术；这个复数名词代指计算本身。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The Greek root is simply the word for number, so arithmetic is the number work par excellence.
normal.cn: 希腊词根就是「数」这个词，因此算术是数字工作的本色代表。

normal.en: Its sentence is the four operations, and everything else in the field is built on top of them.
normal.cn: 它的看家本领是四则运算，领域内其余一切都在其上搭建。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: mental arithmetic, simple arithmetic, arithmetic mean, arithmetic progression.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：心算、简单算术、算术平均、等差数列。

normal.en: The family runs arithmetic, arithmetical, arithmetically, arithmetician.
normal.cn: 同族词包括算术、算术的、按算术方式、算术家。

normal.en: A medieval spelling mixed in the Latin word for art, which is why the modern word looks longer than its Greek source.
normal.cn: 中世纪拼写混入了拉丁语表示「技艺」的词，因此现代词形比其希腊来源更长。

abstract.en: Picture a receipt being added line by line until one hard line is drawn under the total.
abstract.cn: 想象一张收据被逐行相加，直到总数下面画出一道硬线。

abstract.en: Picture four tools laid in a row, and every larger machine in the shop built from exactly those four.
abstract.cn: 想象四件工具排成一行，铺子里所有更大的机器都由这四件搭成。

abstract.en: Picture a vote counted by hand, and the moment the count decides the argument.
abstract.cn: 想象一场用手清点的表决，以及清点结果决定争论的那一刻。

examples.en: He did the arithmetic in his head before signing the contract.
examples.cn: 签合同之前他在心里算了一遍账。

examples.en: Arithmetic is taught before algebra in most schools.
examples.cn: 多数学校先教算术，再教代数。

examples.en: The arithmetic mean of the four measurements is nine.
examples.cn: 四次测量的算术平均是九。

dict_mnemonic.text: 记作「数之艺」：希腊词根就是「数」，加表示技艺的词尾 → 算术、四则运算

root: 希腊 arithmos「数」（更深来源不确定，与「拼合」动词的联系仅为假说）+ arithmētikē tekhnē「计数之艺」；拉丁 arithmetica 经波爱修斯入四艺，中世纪英语拼写混入拉丁「技艺」一词，十六世纪恢复学术拼写。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow the four operations outward: the branch itself, the act of summing, the school hour, the numbers inside a plan, a political count of gains, the attributive use, machine integer work, and the ancient place of number among the four arts.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿四则运算向外展开：分支本身、求和的行为、学校的课时、一项计划里的数字、政治上的得失清点、作定语的用法、机器整数运算，以及数在古代四艺中的位置。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a receipt with lines of numbers added in pencil and a hard line under the total.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张收据，几行数字用铅笔相加，总数下画着一道硬线。

branches.en: Branch and act: the four operations as a subject, and the same four operations performed at a table.
branches.cn: 分支与行为：作为学科的四则运算，与在桌边真做的同一套运算。

branches.en: Taught and used as a modifier: an hour at school, and the attributive form before a noun.
branches.cn: 被教与被当作修饰语：学校里的一节课，以及名词前的定语形式。

branches.en: The numbers inside a plan, and the political count that settles it.
branches.cn: 计划里的数字，与定案的政治清点。

branches.en: The machine: strict rules reproduce the four operations in silicon.
branches.cn: 机器：严格规则在硅片上重演四则运算。

branches.en: The ancient seat: number as one of four named arts in the old curriculum.
branches.cn: 古老的席位：数在旧课程中作为四门具名技艺之一。

intro.en: The word is a Greek noun for number plus a Greek suffix for an art, later reshaped in Latin and English.
intro.cn: 这个词是希腊语表示「数」的名词加表示技艺的希腊后缀，后在拉丁语与英语中改形。

latinIntro.en: Greek arithmos gives the root, -tikē marks the art or skill, and Latin -ica fixed the subject name; English added nothing but a spelling.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语表示数的词提供词根，希腊后缀标记技艺，拉丁词尾固定学科名；英语只改了拼写。

items.example: The root supplies the whole subject matter of the word.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供该词的全部题材。

items.example: The suffix turns a noun into the name of a practised art.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把名词变成一门被实践的技艺之名。

items.example: The adjective supplies the form that Latin and English borrowed.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词提供了拉丁与英语借用的形式。

items.structure: Latin neuter plural used for subject names
items.example: The Latin ending makes the adjective into a school subject.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁词尾把形容词变成学校科目。

items.structure: arithmetica through French and Middle English
items.meaning: the subject; the act of summing
items.example: English keeps one form for the field and the activity.
items.exampleCN: 英语用同一形式兼指学科与活动。

items.example: The adjective is the regular form before a noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词是置于名词前的正规形式。

items.example: The adverb modifies verbs of working or reasoning.
items.exampleCN: 副词修饰运算或推理的动词。

items.example: The person suffix names the practitioner.
items.exampleCN: 表人后缀指从业者。

items.meaning: the sum divided by the count
items.example: The phrase shows the noun working as a modifier.
items.exampleCN: 这个短语显示名词正充当修饰语。

latinEntries.structure: arithmos, arithmou (m., second declension, Greek loan)

definition_zh: 代数；代数学；代数运算与符号体系
definition_en: the branch of mathematics that uses letters and symbols to represent unknown quantities and the relations between them
core_image: 一张纸上左边一堆散开的碎块，右边被拼回一个完整的方，两边用等号连起来
scene: 桌上摊着一张纸，左边画着一堆散开的碎块，右边把它们拼回一个完整的方，两边之间写着等号。The algebra looked impossible until she replaced every unknown with a single letter.
sceneCN: 这里 algebra 指「用符号代表未知量进行运算的代数」（第 1 个义项：代数学）；句意为她把每个未知量都换成一个字母之后，这堆代数才看得懂。图中可辨识物件：碎块、拼合的方、等号、字母标注。

pos.zh: 代数；代数学；代数运算体系

derivatives.zh: 算法（同出一位数学家的名字）

senses.title: The branch that works with symbols
senses.titleCN: 以符号运算的代数分支
senses.definition: the branch of mathematics in which letters stand for unknown or variable quantities
senses.definitionCN: 用字母代表未知量或变量的数学分支
senses.example: The algebra looked impossible until she replaced every unknown with a single letter.
senses.exampleCN: 她把每个未知量都换成一个字母之后，这堆代数才看得懂。
senses.why: The core sense is a way of reasoning about unknowns by giving them names and manipulating those names.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是一种推理方式：给未知量起名字，再摆弄这些名字。

senses.title: The school subject
senses.definition: the subject taught after arithmetic, with equations, formulae and graphs
senses.definitionCN: 在算术之后教授的科目，内容含方程、公式与图像
senses.example: Algebra is timetabled twice a week in the second year.
senses.exampleCN: 二年级每周排两节代数课。
senses.why: Once a branch enters a timetable it becomes a subject, and the word covers the lessons as well as the field.
senses.whyCN: 一门分支一旦进入课表便成为科目，这个词既指领域也指课程。

senses.title: Solving for an unknown
senses.definition: the actual work of rearranging an equation until the unknown stands alone
senses.definitionCN: 把方程反复变形、直到未知量单独站出来的实际工作
senses.example: He used algebra to find how many hours the trip would take.
senses.exampleCN: 他用代数算出这趟要走多少小时。
senses.why: Here the word names the operation performed on paper, not the science of such operations.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词指纸上实际做的运算，而非关于这类运算的学问。

senses.title: A symbolic system or structure
senses.definition: a formal system of symbols with rules for combining them, studied for its own sake
senses.definitionCN: 自带组合规则的形式符号系统，被当作研究对象
senses.example: Group theory studies the algebra of symmetries.
senses.exampleCN: 群论研究对称性的代数结构。
senses.why: Modern mathematics abstracts the schoolroom technique into structures defined only by their rules.
senses.whyCN: 现代数学把课堂上的技巧抽象成只由规则定义的结构。

senses.title: The structure inside another subject
senses.titleCN: 另一学科内部的代数结构
senses.definition: the set of relations and operations that govern a particular system
senses.definitionCN: 支配某一系统的关系与运算的整体
senses.example: The algebra of the network decides which paths are possible.
senses.exampleCN: 这个网络的代数结构决定了哪些路径可行。
senses.why: Any system with combinable parts has an algebra of its own, and the phrase names that structure.
senses.whyCN: 任何部件可以组合的系统都有自己的代数，这个说法指那套结构。

senses.title: Hopelessly abstract symbols
senses.titleCN: 难以看懂的抽象符号（口语）
senses.definition: used informally of writing or reasoning that seems pure symbol-juggling
senses.definitionCN: 口语中指看起来纯粹在摆弄符号的文字或推理
senses.example: To the interns, the risk model was just algebra.
senses.exampleCN: 在实习生看来，那个风险模型不过是一堆代数符号。
senses.why: The everyday use keeps only the surface of the subject, symbols without visible meaning.
senses.whyCN: 日常用法只保留了这门学问的表面，即看不出意义的符号。

senses.title: The old sense of bone-setting
senses.definition: in medieval Latin, the setting of broken bones, from the same Arabic word for reuniting parts
senses.definitionCN: 中世纪拉丁语中指接合断骨，来自同一个表示「把碎块接回」的阿拉伯词
senses.example: Medieval surgeons used the word for the reunion of a fractured limb.
senses.exampleCN: 中世纪外科医生用这个词指把断肢接回。
senses.why: The Arabic term meant restoring what had been broken, whether a limb or a term in an equation.
senses.whyCN: 那个阿拉伯术语意为把弄坏的东西复原，无论是一条肢体还是方程里的一项。

senses.title: The habit of naming the unknown
senses.titleCN: 设未知量为符号的思路
senses.definition: the general strategy of naming what is unknown so that it can be manipulated
senses.definitionCN: 给未知之物命名、以便对它施加运算的一般策略
senses.example: Her method was pure algebra: name the missing factor, then work on the name.
senses.exampleCN: 她的方法纯粹是代数式的：先给缺失的因素命名，再对这个名字动手。
senses.why: The abstract sense keeps only the move that starts the subject, giving the unknown a handle.
senses.whyCN: 抽象义只保留这门学问起手的那个动作：给未知之物一个可以抓握的名字。

intro.en: The word is Arabic. It names the reunion of broken parts, and entered Europe through a ninth-century treatise on calculation. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个词来自阿拉伯语，本义是把碎块接回；它经一部九世纪的计算著作传入欧洲。年代均为约数。

items.en: Jabara meant 'to restore, to reunite, to force'. The noun al-jabr named a restoring or a reunion of what had been broken.
items.cn: jabara 意为「复原、接回、强行」；名词 al-jabr 指把弄坏的东西复原或接回。

items.en: A ninth-century scholar wrote a treatise on calculation by completion and balancing, whose title used al-jabr for the operation of restoring a deficient side of an equation.
items.cn: 一位九世纪学者写了一部关于「补全与平衡」的计算著作，书名用 al-jabr 指把方程中不足的一边补齐的操作。

items.en: Twelfth-century translators rendered the title into Latin as algebra, and the word became the name of the technique in European universities.
items.cn: 十二世纪的译者把书名译成拉丁 algebra，这个词便成了欧洲大学里这门技术的名称。

items.en: Because the Arabic word also meant the reuniting of broken parts of the body, medieval Latin algebra could name the setting of fractures; that sense died out.
items.cn: 由于那个阿拉伯词也指把身体断裂处接回，中世纪拉丁 algebra 可指接骨；这一义项后来消失。

items.en: From the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries algebra was rewritten with letters and signs, and the word came to mean work with symbols rather than with words.
items.cn: 从十六、十七世纪起，代数被用字母与记号重写，这个词便转为指用符号而非文字进行的工作。

items.en: In the nineteenth and twentieth centuries abstract structures took the name, so that algebra now includes systems with no numbers in them at all. First date uncertain: no single year is agreed for this extension.
items.cn: 十九、二十世纪抽象结构也取用了这个名称，因此今天的代数包含完全不含数字的系统。首见年代不确定：这一扩展没有公认的确切年份。

note.en: Group one separates words that look or sound like algebra but come from elsewhere; group two separates the branches that sit beside it.
note.cn: 第一组辨析形音相近而来源不同的词；第二组辨析与它并列的分支。

entries.definition: From the Latinized name of the same ninth-century scholar, but it names a step-by-step procedure, not the study of symbols.
entries.definitionCN: 来自同一位九世纪学者的拉丁化名字，但它指逐步执行的步骤，而非符号之学。

entries.definition: An old word for arithmetic done with Arabic numerals; it looks like algebra but belongs to the history of counting.
entries.definitionCN: 指用阿拉伯数字做算术的旧词；外形像 algebra，实则属于计数史。

entries.definition: A rare spelling that drops the second vowel; the standard adjective is algebraic, and the two are easily confused.
entries.definitionCN: 一种少见的拼写，省去了第二个元音；标准形容词另有其形，二者易混。

entries.definition: The Arabic noun itself, sometimes quoted in histories; it is a foreign term, not an English word for the school subject.
entries.definitionCN: 阿拉伯语名词本身，有时见于史书引文；它是外来术语，不是英语里的学科名。

entries.definition: Works with known numbers and the four operations; algebra begins where letters stand for what is not yet known.
entries.definitionCN: 用已知数字做四则运算；代数的起点是字母代表尚未知道的东西。

entries.definition: Studies shape and space; the two branches meet in coordinate methods but start from different objects.
entries.definitionCN: 研究形与空间；两门分支在坐标方法上相遇，但出发点不同。

entries.definition: Studies rates and totals of changing quantities; it uses algebra but is not a part of it.
entries.definitionCN: 研究变化量的变化率与总量；它使用代数，但并不属于代数。

entries.definition: Studies the properties of whole numbers; it is often done with algebraic tools and remains a separate branch.
entries.definitionCN: 研究整数的性质；常用代数工具，但仍是一门独立分支。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The Arabic word meant the reunion of broken parts, so algebra began as a way of putting a broken equation back together.
normal.cn: 那个阿拉伯词意为把碎块接回，因此代数最初是把破碎的方程重新拼合的办法。

normal.en: The trick is to give the unknown a name, and then treat the name as if it were a number.
normal.cn: 诀窍在于给未知之物一个名字，然后把这个名字当作数字来对待。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the branches: linear algebra, abstract algebra, elementary algebra.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出分支：线性代数、抽象代数、初等代数。

normal.en: The family runs algebra, algebraic, algebraically, algebraist, and the distant relative algorithm.
normal.cn: 同族词包括代数、代数的、用代数方法、代数学家，以及远亲「算法」。

normal.en: The same Arabic root also named bone-setting, since a fracture is also a broken thing to be reunited.
normal.cn: 同一个阿拉伯词根也指接骨，因为骨折同样是把断开之物接回。

abstract.en: Picture a torn page being reassembled from fragments until the sentence reads again.
abstract.cn: 想象一页撕碎的书页被碎片重新拼好，直到句子又能读通。

abstract.en: Picture a sealed box given a label, so that people can carry it and stack it without opening it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只封好的箱子被贴上标签，于是人们不必打开就能搬运与堆放。

abstract.en: Picture a balance scale where weights are moved from one pan to the other until it levels.
abstract.cn: 想象一架天平，砝码在两盘之间移动，直到它持平。

examples.en: She learned algebra before she learned to drive.
examples.cn: 她学代数还在学开车之前。

examples.en: The software solves the algebra behind the animation.
examples.cn: 这款软件解出动画背后的代数式。

examples.en: Linear algebra is the language of much modern statistics.
examples.cn: 线性代数是许多现代统计学的语言。

dict_mnemonic.text: 记作「接回碎块」：阿拉伯语本义把断开的部分接回去 → 代数

root: 阿拉伯 al-jabr「接回、复原」，出自九世纪「补全与平衡」的计算著作，经十二世纪拉丁译名进入欧洲；同一词根在中世纪拉丁语中也指接骨；十六、十七世纪改为符号运算，十九、二十世纪扩展出抽象结构义。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one move, giving the unknown a name: the branch, the school hour, the working of an equation, a formal structure, the structure inside another system, a heap of opaque symbols, the old art of bone-setting, and the bare habit of naming what is missing.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开，即给未知之物命名：学科、课时、解方程的实际操作、形式结构、他系统内部的结构、一堆看不懂的符号、旧时的接骨术，以及给缺失之物命名这一最朴素的习惯。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: fragments on one side of a page, a whole square on the other, an equal sign between them.
core.cn: 核心意象：纸左边是碎块，右边是一个完整的方，两者之间一个等号。

branches.en: Branch and working: the study of symbols, and the handwork of isolating an unknown.
branches.cn: 分支与操作：关于符号的学问，与把未知量单独留出的手上功夫。

branches.en: The classroom and the complaint: a timetabled hour, and a page that looks like mere symbol-juggling.
branches.cn: 课堂与抱怨：课表上的一节，以及一页看似只摆弄符号的内容。

branches.en: Structure at two scales: a system defined by its own rules, and the same idea inside a network.
branches.cn: 两个尺度的结构：由自身规则定义的系统，以及网络内部的同一想法。

branches.en: The broken body: a fracture is also something to be reunited, which is why the word once meant bone-setting.
branches.cn: 破碎的身体：骨折也是待接回之物，因此这个词曾指接骨。

branches.en: The bare move: name what is missing, then work on the name.
branches.cn: 最朴素的动作：给缺失之物命名，再对名字动手。

intro.en: The word is Arabic in origin, so its parts are Arabic rather than Latin; the English family around it, however, is built with Latin and Greek endings.
intro.cn: 这个词源自阿拉伯语，因此其部件是阿拉伯语的而非拉丁语的；但它周围的英语词族是用拉丁与希腊词尾构成的。

latinIntro.en: Arabic jabara and the noun al-jabr supply the meaning; the article al- is part of the word as Europe borrowed it.
latinIntro.cn: 阿拉伯语动词与名词提供意义；冠词 al- 在欧洲借入时已成为词的一部分。

items.example: The article travelled with the noun into European languages.
items.exampleCN: 冠词随名词一起进入欧洲语言。

items.example: The noun carries the image of making a broken thing whole.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词带着「把破碎之物变完整」的意象。

items.example: The phrase names the operation of completing a deficient side.
items.exampleCN: 这个短语指把不足的一边补齐的操作。

items.meaning: the technique of restoring and balancing
items.example: Latin kept the Arabic article inside the word.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语把阿拉伯语冠词保留在词内。

items.example: The Latin suffix makes the borrowed noun into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁词尾把借来的名词变成形容词。

items.example: The adverb marks the method used.
items.exampleCN: 副词标记所用的方法。

items.example: The person suffix is added to the borrowed stem.
items.exampleCN: 表人后缀加在借来的词干上。

items.structure: from the Latinized name of al-Khwarizmi
items.example: The neighbour word comes from the scholar, not from the noun for reunion.
items.exampleCN: 邻近的词来自那位学者，而非表示接回的名词。

items.meaning: the algebra of vectors and matrices
items.example: The phrase shows the noun modified by a branch name.
items.exampleCN: 这个短语显示名词被分支名修饰。

latinEntries.structure: algebra, algebrae (f., Medieval Latin, from Arabic)
latinEntries.meaning: the art of restoring and balancing

definition_zh: 代数的；用代数方法的；由代数符号表示的
definition_en: relating to algebra or to its methods; expressed or solved by means of symbols rather than by arithmetic
core_image: 纸上一个未知量被圈出，四周的项被依次搬到等号另一边，符号像被搬动的棋子
scene: 草稿纸上一个未知量被圈住，四周的项被逐项搬到等号另一边，符号像被搬动的棋子。The relation is algebraic, so it can be rearranged without knowing any of the numbers.
sceneCN: 这里 algebraic 指「属于代数的、用代数符号处理的」（第 1 个义项：与代数方法相关）；句意为这个关系是代数式的，不必知道任何具体数字就能变形。图中可辨识物件：草稿纸、圈出的未知量、等号、搬动的项。

pos.zh: 代数的；用代数方法的；代数符号表示的

senses.title: Belonging to algebra
senses.definition: relating to algebra as a branch of mathematics
senses.definitionCN: 与作为数学分支的代数有关
senses.example: The relation is algebraic, so it can be rearranged without knowing any of the numbers.
senses.exampleCN: 这个关系是代数式的，不必知道任何具体数字就能变形。
senses.why: The plainest reading attaches the branch's name to whatever is described.
senses.whyCN: 最朴素的用法把分支之名挂到所描述的对象上。

senses.title: Written in symbols
senses.definition: expressed by letters and signs instead of by worked-out numbers
senses.definitionCN: 用字母与记号表达，而非用算好的数字表达
senses.example: She rewrote the sentence as an algebraic expression.
senses.exampleCN: 她把那句话改写成一个代数式。
senses.why: Whatever is put into symbolic form takes the adjective, because the symbols are the visible mark of the branch.
senses.whyCN: 凡被写成符号形式的东西都带这个形容词，因为符号是这门分支的可见标记。

senses.title: Solvable by root extraction
senses.definition: describing an equation that can be solved by the operations of algebra, as opposed to one needing new kinds of numbers
senses.definitionCN: 描述可用代数运算求解的方程，以区别于需要新数类的方程
senses.example: Every quadratic equation is algebraic, but not every equation is.
senses.exampleCN: 每个二次方程都是代数可解的，但并非每个方程都如此。
senses.why: Historians of the subject needed a word for the solvable class, and the branch's name supplied it.
senses.whyCN: 这门学问的史家需要一个词来指「可解」的那一类，分支之名便提供了它。

senses.title: Of a root of a polynomial
senses.definition: describing a number that is a root of a polynomial with whole-number coefficients
senses.definitionCN: 描述作为整系数多项式之根的数目
senses.example: The square root of two is algebraic, though it is not a fraction.
senses.exampleCN: 二的平方根是代数数，尽管它不是分数。
senses.why: This technical sense sorts numbers by how they can be reached from whole numbers.
senses.whyCN: 这一技术义按「能否由整数到达」来给数分类。

senses.title: Of a formal structure
senses.definition: describing a set with operations that obey stated rules, studied as an object in itself
senses.definitionCN: 描述一个带有满足既定规则的运算的集合，被当作对象研究
senses.example: A ring is an algebraic structure with two operations.
senses.exampleCN: 环是一种带两个运算的代数结构。
senses.why: Modern mathematics treats rules themselves as objects, and the adjective marks that level of abstraction.
senses.whyCN: 现代数学把规则本身当作对象，这个形容词标记那一抽象层次。

senses.title: Of a branch built on algebra
senses.titleCN: 代数几何、代数拓扑等分支的
senses.definition: used in the names of fields that combine algebra with geometry or topology
senses.definitionCN: 用于代数与几何或拓扑结合而成的领域名称
senses.example: She works in algebraic geometry, where shapes are described by equations.
senses.exampleCN: 她研究代数几何，那里用方程描述形状。
senses.why: When a field joins two subjects, the name of the contributing branch becomes its modifier.
senses.whyCN: 当一个领域结合两门学问时，贡献方之名便成为它的修饰语。

senses.title: Abstract to the point of symbols
senses.titleCN: 抽象到只剩符号的（比喻）
senses.definition: used of reasoning so abstract that it seems to be only manipulation of signs
senses.definitionCN: 描述抽象到仿佛只在摆弄记号、别无其他的推理
senses.example: His explanation was too algebraic for the committee to follow.
senses.exampleCN: 他的解释过于代数化，委员会跟不上。
senses.why: The figurative use criticises work that keeps the form of algebra while losing its connection to anything concrete.
senses.whyCN: 比喻用法批评那种保留了代数外形、却与具体事物脱节的做法。

senses.title: Treatable by symbolic manipulation
senses.definition: capable of being handled by rearranging symbols according to rules
senses.definitionCN: 能够按规则重排符号来处理的
senses.example: Once the problem became algebraic, a machine could rearrange it overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 问题一旦变成代数形式，机器就能连夜把它重排。
senses.why: Anything reducible to symbols can be processed without knowing the values, which is the practical power the adjective marks.
senses.whyCN: 凡可化为符号者都能在不取值的情况下被处理，这正是这个形容词所标的实用力量。

intro.en: The adjective is the borrowed Arabic noun plus a Latin adjectival ending, formed in European Latin before English used it. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个形容词是借入的阿拉伯语名词加拉丁形容词词尾，先在欧洲拉丁语中构成，后为英语所用。年代均为约数。

items.en: The Arabic noun meant a reunion or restoration of broken parts, and named the operation of completing a deficient side of an equation.
items.cn: 这个阿拉伯名词意为把破碎部分接回或复原，并指把方程中不足的一边补齐的操作。

items.en: Twelfth-century translators brought the word into Latin as algebra, where it named the technique of restoring and balancing.
items.cn: 十二世纪译者把它作为 algebra 带入拉丁语，指补全与平衡的技术。

items.en: The adjectival suffix -icus, inherited from Greek -ikos, was added to the borrowed stem to make a describing word.
items.cn: 形容词后缀 -icus 承自希腊语，被加到借来的词干上以构成描述词。

items.en: Scholars formed the adjective in Latin before it appeared in English, so the word came in already built.
items.cn: 学者先在拉丁语中构成这个形容词，然后才进入英语，因此它是整体借入的。

items.en: English uses the adjective for equations, expressions, structures and numbers, always attaching it to something the branch can describe.
items.cn: 英语把这个形容词用于方程、式子、结构与数，总是挂到这门分支所能描述的对象上。

items.en: In modern mathematics it also marks the class of numbers and equations reachable by algebraic operations. First date uncertain: this narrowing developed gradually, with no agreed first citation.
items.cn: 在现代数学中，它还标记可由代数运算到达的那一类数与方程。首见年代不确定：这一收窄是逐渐形成的，没有公认的最早书证。

note.en: Group one separates the adjective from words of the same family; group two separates other adjectives of method.
note.cn: 第一组辨析这个形容词与其同族词；第二组辨析其他表示方法的形容词。

entries.definition: The branch itself; the adjective differs only by its ending, which is easy to overlook in a quick scan.
entries.definitionCN: 指分支本身；形容词只差词尾，快速扫读时容易忽略。

entries.definition: A worker in the branch; the ending marks a person rather than a property.
entries.definitionCN: 指该分支的工作者；词尾标出人而非性质。

entries.definition: An older and longer adjective found in older texts; modern usage prefers the shorter form.
entries.definitionCN: 见于较早文献的更长形容词；现代用法多用较短形式。

entries.definition: From the scholar's name rather than from the noun for reunion: it describes procedures, not symbol systems.
entries.definitionCN: 来自那位学者的名字而非表示接回的名词：它描述步骤，而非符号系统。

entries.definition: Describes anything that stands for something else; algebraic work is symbolic, but symbolic work need not be algebra.
entries.definitionCN: 描述任何以某物代表另一物的东西；代数工作是符号性的，但符号性工作未必是代数。

entries.definition: Describes work done with actual values, the opposite of keeping everything in letters.
entries.definitionCN: 描述用实际数值所做的工作，与把一切留在字母里相反。

entries.definition: Describes work that follows stated rules of symbol manipulation regardless of interpretation.
entries.definitionCN: 描述按既定符号操作规则进行、不问解释的工作。

entries.definition: Describes what is separated from particular cases; algebraic structures are abstract, though not every abstract thing is algebraic.
entries.definitionCN: 描述与具体事例脱开之物；代数结构是抽象的，但并非每个抽象物都是代数的。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The adjective is the branch's borrowed name plus a Latin ending, so it marks whatever the branch can describe.
normal.cn: 这个形容词是分支借来的名称加拉丁词尾，因此标记这门分支所能描述的一切。

normal.en: Its home phrases are equation, expression, structure and number, four things the branch handles.
normal.cn: 它的常用搭配是方程、式子、结构与数，正是这门分支处理的四样东西。

normal.en: The family runs algebraic, algebra, algebraically, algebraist, and the older algebraical.
normal.cn: 同族词包括代数的、代数、用代数方法、代数学家，以及更旧的形容词形式。

normal.en: Algebraic numbers are those reachable from whole numbers by polynomial equations, which is a boundary rather than a compliment.
normal.cn: 代数数指能由整数经多项式方程到达的数；这是一条界线，而不是一句称赞。

normal.en: The word can also dismiss an argument: too algebraic means correct in form but empty of meaning.
normal.cn: 这个词也可用来否定一个论证：太代数化意味着形式正确却空洞。

abstract.en: Picture chess pieces moved by rule alone, with no board and no opponent.
abstract.cn: 想象棋子只按规则移动，却没有棋盘也没有对手。

abstract.en: Picture a letter standing in for a name that nobody has yet been told.
abstract.cn: 想象一个字母代替一个还没人被告知的名字。

abstract.en: Picture a lock made of symbols, opening only when the signs are shifted in the right order.
abstract.cn: 想象一把由符号构成的锁，只有按正确次序搬动记号才打开。

examples.en: The two quantities are linked by a simple algebraic relation.
examples.cn: 这两个量由一个简单的代数关系连起来。

examples.en: Students translate word problems into algebraic form.
examples.cn: 学生把应用题转成代数形式。

examples.en: Algebraic methods settled the question without any measurement.
examples.cn: 代数方法无需任何测量就解决了这个问题。

dict_mnemonic.text: 记作「接回碎块的」：阿拉伯语名词加拉丁形容词尾巴 → 代数的

root: 阿拉伯 al-jabr「接回、复原」经中世纪拉丁 algebra 进入欧洲，加拉丁形容词后缀 -icus 构成；英语整体借入，用于方程、式子、结构与数，并在现代数学中收窄出「代数可解」与「代数数」等技术义。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses radiate from one adjective: belonging to the branch, written in symbols, solvable by its operations, describing algebraic numbers, naming formal structures, modifying sister fields, sounding emptily abstract, and reducible to rule-governed rewriting.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从一个形容词辐射开：属于该分支、写成符号、可由其运算求解、描述代数数、命名形式结构、修饰姊妹领域、听起来空洞抽象，以及可化为按规则重写。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one circled unknown, with the surrounding terms carried across an equal sign like chess pieces.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个被圈出的未知量，四周的项像棋子一样被搬到等号另一边。

branches.en: The branch and its writing: whatever is put into letters belongs to algebra.
branches.cn: 分支与写法：凡被写成字母者都属于代数。

branches.en: Reachability: equations that its operations can solve, and numbers that its polynomials can reach.
branches.cn: 可到达性：其运算能解的方程，与其多项式能到达的数。

branches.en: Rules as objects: a structure studied for itself, and any problem reducible to rewriting.
branches.cn: 规则作为对象：被自身研究的结构，以及任何可化为重写的问题。

branches.en: The sister fields: geometry and topology borrow the name as a prefix.
branches.cn: 姊妹领域：几何与拓扑把这个名字借去当前缀。

branches.en: The empty form: symbols kept after meaning has left, which is the word as a criticism.
branches.cn: 空形式：意义离开后留下的符号，也就是作为批评的这个词。

intro.en: The stem is Arabic, but every ending on the English adjective is Latin or Greek, so the word reads as a borrowed root wearing European grammar.
intro.cn: 词干来自阿拉伯语，但这个英语形容词上的每个词尾都是拉丁或希腊的，因此这个词读起来像一个披着欧洲语法的借来词根。

latinIntro.en: Arabic al-jabr supplies the meaning; Latin -icus supplies the word class, and English adds only pronunciation.
latinIntro.cn: 阿拉伯语名词提供意义，拉丁后缀提供词类，英语只添了读音。

items.example: The borrowed stem carries the whole image of the word.
items.exampleCN: 借来的词干承载这个词的全部意象。

items.meaning: the technique of restoring and balancing
items.example: Latin made the Arabic noun into a subject name.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语把这个阿拉伯名词变成学科名。

items.meaning: belonging to; of the nature of
items.example: The suffix turns the subject name into a describing word.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把学科名变成描述词。

items.example: The older longer adjective added a second ending.
items.exampleCN: 更旧的较长形容词又加了一个词尾。

items.example: The word describes anything the branch can handle.
items.exampleCN: 这个词描述这门分支能处理的一切。

items.example: The adverb marks the method rather than the object.
items.exampleCN: 副词标记方法而非对象。

items.example: The person suffix is the only native-feeling addition.
items.exampleCN: 表人后缀是唯一读起来像本土添加的部分。

items.meaning: a root of a polynomial with integer coefficients
items.example: The phrase shows the technical narrowing in use.
items.exampleCN: 这个短语展示了技术性收窄的用法。

items.example: The rare verb names the act of translation into symbols.
items.exampleCN: 这个罕用动词指译成符号的行为。

latinEntries.structure: algebra, algebrae (f., Medieval Latin, from Arabic)
latinEntries.meaning: the art of restoring and balancing

definition_zh: 几何学；几何形状；（某空间的）几何结构
definition_en: the branch of mathematics that deals with the size, shape and relative position of figures, and with the properties of space
core_image: 一张方格纸上，几个角被量角器逐一读过，边与边的关系被写成比例
scene: 桌上摊着一张方格纸，有人用量角器逐个读角，把边与边的关系写成比例。The geometry of the room made every doorway awkward.
sceneCN: 这里 geometry 指「空间的形状与位置关系」（第 2 个义项：某物的几何构形）；句意为这间屋子的几何构形使每个门口都别扭。图中可辨识物件：方格纸、量角器、角度标记、比例式。

pos.zh: 几何学；几何形状；几何结构

senses.title: The branch that studies shape
senses.titleCN: 研究形与空间的几何学
senses.definition: the branch of mathematics concerned with shape, size and the properties of space
senses.definitionCN: 研究形状、大小与空间性质的数学分支
senses.example: Geometry began with questions about triangles and circles.
senses.exampleCN: 几何学最初研究的是三角形与圆的问题。
senses.why: The core sense names a whole branch whose objects are figures and whose method is deduction from stated assumptions.
senses.whyCN: 核心义命名一门完整分支，其对象是图形，其方法是从既定前提演绎。

senses.title: The shape of a particular thing
senses.titleCN: 某一具体事物的几何构形
senses.definition: the actual arrangement of lines, angles and surfaces in an object or place
senses.definitionCN: 某物或某处线条、角度与表面的实际排布
senses.example: The geometry of the room made every doorway awkward.
senses.exampleCN: 这间屋子的几何构形使每个门口都别扭。
senses.why: Any physical arrangement can be described in the branch's terms, so the word transfers to the arrangement itself.
senses.whyCN: 任何实际排布都能用这门分支的术语描述，于是这个词转到排布本身上。

senses.title: The school subject
senses.definition: the subject taught in schools, with constructions, proofs and calculations about figures
senses.definitionCN: 学校所授科目，内容含作图、证明与图形计算
senses.example: Geometry is where students first meet a formal proof.
senses.exampleCN: 学生第一次接触形式证明，通常是在几何课上。
senses.why: Because proof is taught there first, the word also names the hour and the exercises.
senses.whyCN: 由于证明最先在这里被教授，这个词也指那节课与那些练习。

senses.title: The structure of a space
senses.definition: the system of distances and relations that holds in a given space, flat or curved
senses.definitionCN: 某一空间（平坦或弯曲）中距离与关系的体系
senses.example: The geometry of the harbour changes as the tide moves the sand.
senses.exampleCN: 随着潮水搬动沙子，港湾的几何结构也在改变。
senses.why: Modern mathematics treats space itself as something with a structure, and the word names that structure.
senses.whyCN: 现代数学把空间本身当作有结构的东西，这个词便指那套结构。

senses.title: How figures are laid out
senses.titleCN: 图形在空间中的排布构造
senses.definition: the pattern in which shapes are placed relative to one another, as in a building or a crystal
senses.definitionCN: 若干形状彼此相对摆放所形成的格局，如建筑或晶体中者
senses.example: The cathedral's geometry repeats one triangle at every scale.
senses.exampleCN: 这座大教堂的几何构造在每一尺度上重复同一个三角形。
senses.why: Design and nature both produce arrangements that can be read as figures, so the branch name follows them.
senses.whyCN: 设计与自然都产生可读作图形的排布，于是分支之名随之而行。

senses.title: The old sense of land measurement
senses.definition: in its Greek origin, the measuring of land, which is what the name literally says
senses.definitionCN: 在其希腊来源中指丈量土地，这正是名称字面所说的
senses.example: The word's oldest sense is surveying, not proof.
senses.exampleCN: 这个词最古老的义项是丈量，而不是证明。
senses.why: The name records its own beginning: fields had to be measured after every flood.
senses.whyCN: 名称记录了它自己的开端：每次洪水之后，田地都要重新丈量。

senses.title: A named system of space
senses.titleCN: 具名的空间体系（如欧氏几何）
senses.definition: a particular set of assumptions about space, such as the Euclidean or the spherical
senses.definitionCN: 关于空间的一组特定前提，如欧氏的或球面的
senses.example: Non-Euclidean geometry was once thought to be a contradiction.
senses.exampleCN: 非欧几何一度被认为是自相矛盾的。
senses.why: Once several systems existed side by side, the word needed to name each one, and the branch name became countable.
senses.whyCN: 当几套体系并存之后，这个词需要逐一命名，分支名也就变成可数的了。

senses.title: The spatial logic of a situation
senses.definition: used figuratively for the way the parts of a problem are arranged relative to one another
senses.definitionCN: 比喻一个问题各部分彼此相对的位置关系
senses.example: The geometry of the negotiation left the smaller party no room.
senses.exampleCN: 谈判的「几何」让小的一方没有余地。
senses.why: The figurative use keeps only the notion of positions and distances, transferred to people and interests.
senses.whyCN: 比喻用法只保留位置与距离的观念，把它移用到人与利益上。

intro.en: The word is Greek for land measurement, a compound of 'earth' and 'measure'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个词在希腊语中意为丈量土地，由「土地」与「量度」合成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Ge meant 'earth, land', and survives in many scientific compounds. Its earlier forms are reconstructed rather than directly attested.
items.cn: ge 意为「土地、大地」，见于许多科学复合词。其更早形态属重构形式，并非直接实证。

items.en: Metron meant 'measure', and gave the verb metrein 'to measure' and the suffix -metria 'measuring'.
items.cn: metron 意为「量度」，由此有动词 metrein「测量」与后缀 -metria「测量」。

items.en: Geōmetria meant 'land measurement', the practical surveying needed to re-establish field boundaries after the Nile flood.
items.cn: geōmetria 意为「丈量土地」，即尼罗河泛滥后重新划定田界所需的实用测量。

items.en: Geōmetrēs, 'land-measurer', named the person, and the abstract noun named the skill before it named a science.
items.cn: geōmetrēs「丈量者」指人，而抽象名词先指技艺，后指一门科学。

items.en: Latin geometria entered the school curriculum and, through Boethius, became one of the four mathematical arts.
items.cn: 拉丁 geometria 进入学校课程，并经波爱修斯之手成为四门数学技艺之一。

items.en: English took the word from French in the fourteenth century; the sense 'shape of a particular thing' is a later transfer. First date uncertain: no single year is agreed for that transfer.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪经法语吸收这个词；「某具体事物的形状」义是较晚的转移。首见年代不确定：这一转移没有公认的确切年份。

note.en: Group one separates words that look close but name other things; group two separates the neighbouring branches.
note.cn: 第一组辨析外形相近而所指不同的词；第二组辨析相邻的分支。

entries.definition: Built from the same word for earth plus a verb for writing: it describes the surface of the planet, not the properties of figures.
entries.definitionCN: 同用表示大地的词，但配的是表示书写的动词：它描述地表，而非图形性质。

entries.definition: Earth plus a word for discourse: it studies rocks and the structure of the planet.
entries.definitionCN: 大地加表示论述的词：研究岩石与行星结构。

entries.definition: A worker in geometry; it differs from the field name only in its ending.
entries.definitionCN: 指几何工作者；与学科名只差词尾。

entries.definition: The countable plural names distinct systems, as in 'two geometries'; the uncountable singular names the branch.
entries.definitionCN: 可数复数指不同的体系，如「两种几何」；不可数单数指这门分支。

entries.definition: Reasons about unknown quantities through symbols; geometry reasons about figures through construction and proof.
entries.definitionCN: 通过符号推究未知量；几何通过作图与证明推究图形。

entries.definition: Measures triangles through ratios of sides; it began as a tool for astronomy and surveying.
entries.definitionCN: 通过边之比来量三角形；最初是天文学与测量的工具。

entries.definition: Studies properties that survive stretching but not cutting; it drops the measurements geometry keeps.
entries.definitionCN: 研究拉伸而不切割仍不变的性质；它舍弃了几何所保留的量度。

entries.definition: The craft of measuring land, which is what the Greek name first meant; it is practice, not proof.
entries.definitionCN: 丈量土地的技艺，正是这个希腊名称的原义；它是实务，而非证明。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The name literally says land measurement, so the branch began in fields rather than in classrooms.
normal.cn: 名称字面就是丈量土地，因此这门分支起于田间，而非课堂。

normal.en: Its objects are figures, and its method is to start from a few stated assumptions and deduce the rest.
normal.cn: 它的对象是图形，方法是先立下少数前提，再推出其余。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the systems: plane geometry, solid geometry, Euclidean geometry, coordinate geometry.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出各体系：平面几何、立体几何、欧氏几何、解析几何。

normal.en: The family runs geometry, geometric, geometrically, geometer, geometrician.
normal.cn: 同族词包括几何、几何的、在几何上、几何学家、几何学专家。

normal.en: The word can leave mathematics altogether: the geometry of a room is simply how its parts are arranged.
normal.cn: 这个词可以完全离开数学：一间屋子的几何，就是它各部分如何摆放。

abstract.en: Picture a flooded field being re-divided with rope and pegs until every boundary is straight again.
abstract.cn: 想象一片被淹过的田，用绳与桩重新划分，直到每条田界又直起来。

abstract.en: Picture a tiled floor whose pattern continues past the edge of what you can see.
abstract.cn: 想象一片铺砖的地面，图案延伸到你目力所及之外。

abstract.en: Picture a negotiation as a map, with each party standing at a measurable distance from the others.
abstract.cn: 想象把一场谈判画成地图，每一方都站在离别人可量的距离上。

examples.en: Geometry was the first subject in which proofs were taught.
examples.cn: 几何是最早教授证明的科目。

examples.en: The geometry of the valley funnels the wind into one narrow pass.
examples.cn: 山谷的几何结构把风聚进一条狭窄的通道。

examples.en: She used coordinate geometry to check the design.
examples.cn: 她用解析几何核对设计。

dict_mnemonic.text: 记作「量地」：大地加量度 → 丈量土地 → 几何学

root: 希腊 ge「土地」+ metron「量度」合成 geōmetria「丈量土地」，本是洪水后重划田界的实用测量；经拉丁 geometria 入四艺，英语十四世纪自法语借入，后引申出「某物的几何构形」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses run from the branch itself to the shape of one object, the school hour, the structure of a space, the layout of figures, the old craft of surveying, a named system of space, and finally the spatial logic of a dispute.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从分支本身，依次到某一物的形状、学校的课时、空间的结构、图形的排布、古老的丈量手艺、具名的空间体系，最后到一场争执的空间逻辑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a surveyed field, re-marked with rope and pegs until the boundaries are straight.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片被重新丈量的田，用绳与桩标直了田界。

branches.en: The science and its origin: proof grew out of the need to re-measure fields.
branches.cn: 学问与其源头：证明从重新丈量田地的需要中长出。

branches.en: Shape at two sizes: one room's angles, and a cathedral repeating one triangle.
branches.cn: 两个尺度的形：一间屋子的角，与一座重复同一三角形的教堂。

branches.en: Taught and systematised: a proof in class, and a named set of assumptions about space.
branches.cn: 被教与被系统化：课堂上的一份证明，与一组具名的空间前提。

branches.en: The structure of space itself, flat or curved, fixed by distances.
branches.cn: 空间自身的结构，平坦或弯曲，由距离确定。

branches.en: Positions without figures: parties in a dispute standing at measurable distances.
branches.cn: 没有图形的方位：争执各方站在可量的距离上。

intro.en: The word is a Greek compound of two free-standing nouns, and the same two pieces appear in many scientific terms.
intro.cn: 这个词是两个独立希腊名词的复合，同样的两个部件也出现在许多科学术语中。

latinIntro.en: Greek ge 'earth' and metron 'measure' combine without a connecting suffix; Latin kept the compound intact.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语表示土地的词与表示量度的词直接组合，不加连接后缀；拉丁语把整个复合词保留下来。

items.example: The first element limits the measuring to land.
items.exampleCN: 第一个成分把测量限定在土地上。

items.example: The second element supplies the act of measuring.
items.exampleCN: 第二个成分提供测量这一动作。

items.example: The suffix turns the compound into the name of a skill.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把复合词变成技艺之名。

items.example: Latin borrowed the Greek compound whole.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语把希腊复合词整体借入。

items.meaning: the branch; the shape of a thing
items.example: English keeps both the branch sense and the transferred shape sense.
items.exampleCN: 英语既保留分支义，也保留转移而来的形状义。

items.example: The adjective marks whatever belongs to figures or to the branch.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词标记属于图形或该分支之物。

items.meaning: one who measures land or studies figures
items.example: The person suffix names the worker.
items.exampleCN: 表人后缀指工作者。

items.example: The longer person form is the formal title.
items.exampleCN: 较长的表人形式是正式称谓。

items.example: The adverb marks the terms in which something is described.
items.exampleCN: 副词标记描述所用的术语。

latinEntries.structure: geometres, geometrou (m., first declension, Greek loan)
metrum, metri (n., second declension, from Greek)

definition_zh: 几何的；几何图形的；按几何级数变化的
definition_en: relating to geometry or to patterns built from simple shapes; also, increasing or decreasing by a constant ratio
core_image: 地砖上的方与三角依次套叠，每一层都把上一层按同一比例放大
scene: 地砖上是方与三角套叠的图案，每一层都把上一层按同一比例放大。The tiles form a geometric pattern of squares inside squares.
sceneCN: 这里 geometric 指「由规则几何图形构成的」（第 2 个义项：图形化的几何构成）；句意为这些砖构成方中套方的几何图案。图中可辨识物件：地砖、正方形、三角形、放大比例。

pos.zh: 几何的；几何图形的；按固定比例增减的

senses.title: Belonging to geometry
senses.definition: relating to the branch of mathematics that studies shape and space
senses.definitionCN: 与研究形与空间的数学分支有关
senses.example: The proof uses a geometric argument about similar triangles.
senses.exampleCN: 这个证明用了一个关于相似三角形的几何论证。
senses.why: The plainest reading attaches the branch's name to the thing described.
senses.whyCN: 最朴素的用法把分支之名挂到所描述的对象上。

senses.title: Built from simple shapes
senses.definition: made up of regular shapes such as circles, squares and triangles
senses.definitionCN: 由圆、方、三角等规则图形组成
senses.example: The tiles form a geometric pattern of squares inside squares.
senses.exampleCN: 这些砖构成方中套方的几何图案。
senses.why: A pattern is called geometric when its parts are exact figures rather than organic or irregular forms.
senses.whyCN: 当图案的部件是精确图形而非有机、不规则形状时，就称它为几何的。

senses.title: Changing by a constant ratio
senses.definition: describing a sequence in which each term is a fixed multiple of the one before
senses.definitionCN: 描述每一项都是前一项固定倍数的数列
senses.example: Bacteria in a fresh dish grow in a geometric progression.
senses.exampleCN: 新培养皿里的细菌按等比速度增长。
senses.why: This sense comes from proportion rather than from shape: in Greek usage the word covered ratios as well as figures.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项来自比例而非形状：在希腊语用法中，这个词既涵盖图形，也涵盖比值。

senses.title: Of a mean found by multiplying
senses.definition: describing the mean obtained by multiplying values and taking a root, rather than by adding
senses.definitionCN: 描述通过相乘再开方、而非相加得到的平均数
senses.example: The geometric mean of four and nine is six.
senses.exampleCN: 四与九的几何平均是六。
senses.why: Algebraic operations named after figures because early proofs of them were drawn as areas.
senses.whyCN: 以图形命名的代数运算，因为早期对它们的证明要画成面积。

senses.title: Severely regular in design
senses.definition: describing design or art that uses straight lines, exact angles and repeated units
senses.definitionCN: 描述使用直线、精确角度与重复单元的设计或艺术
senses.example: The façade is geometric, with no curve anywhere.
senses.exampleCN: 这面外墙是几何式的，没有一处曲线。
senses.why: Design is called geometric when its units are exact figures repeated by rule rather than shaped by hand.
senses.whyCN: 当设计的单元是精确图形、按规则重复而非手工塑形时，便称它为几何式的。

senses.title: Of geometric abstraction in art
senses.definition: belonging to a modern style that reduces images to circles, rectangles and grids
senses.definitionCN: 属于把形象简化为圆、矩形与网格的现代风格
senses.example: Mondrian's geometric canvases were once thought cold.
senses.exampleCN: 蒙德里安的几何画作一度被认为冷冰冰。
senses.why: The style took its name from the figures it used, so the adjective became a label for a movement.
senses.whyCN: 这一风格以所用图形为名，于是这个形容词成了流派的标签。

senses.title: Describable in exact spatial terms
senses.titleCN: 可用精确空间关系描述的
senses.definition: described by distances, angles and positions rather than by feel
senses.definitionCN: 用距离、角度与位置来描述，而非凭感觉
senses.example: The dancer's turns became geometric once the cameras measured them.
senses.exampleCN: 一旦摄像机量过，舞者的转身就变得几何化了。
senses.why: Any motion reduced to coordinates can be described geometrically, which is what the adjective claims.
senses.whyCN: 任何化为坐标的运动都可用几何方式描述，这正是这个形容词所主张的。

senses.title: As strict as a construction
senses.titleCN: 像作图一样严格的（比喻）
senses.definition: used of reasoning that proceeds step by step with no room for approximation
senses.definitionCN: 描述一步一步推进、不容许近似余地的推理
senses.example: His refusal was geometric: each condition ruled out the next.
senses.exampleCN: 他的拒绝像作图一样严格：每个条件都排除了下一步。
senses.why: The figurative use borrows the certainty of a construction, where each line is forced by the previous one.
senses.whyCN: 比喻用法借用作图的确定性：每条线都被前一条逼出来。

intro.en: The adjective is the Greek noun for land measurement plus the Greek suffix for 'belonging to'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个形容词是希腊语表示丈量土地的名词加表示「属于」的希腊后缀。年代均为约数。

items.en: Geōmetria meant 'land measurement', a compound of ge 'earth' and metron 'measure'.
items.cn: geōmetria 意为「丈量土地」，由表示土地的词与表示量度的词合成。

items.en: Geōmetrikos 'of measuring land, skilled in geometry' was formed with -ikos, the suffix of belonging.
items.cn: geōmetrikos「丈量土地的、精于几何的」由表示「属于」的后缀构成。

items.en: Latin took the adjective as geometricus alongside the noun geometria, and both entered the schools together.
items.cn: 拉丁语把形容词作为 geometricus 与名词一并吸收，两者一同进入学校。

items.en: English uses the adjective from the sixteenth century for proofs, figures and designs, and the longer variant survives in older texts.
items.cn: 英语自十六世纪起用这个形容词指证明、图形与设计，较长的变体留在较早文献中。

items.en: Greek usage already covered proportion, so the adjective could describe a constant ratio as well as a shape; this is why a progression can be geometric.
items.cn: 希腊语用法已涵盖比例，因此这个形容词既能描述形状，也能描述固定比值；这正是数列也能称「几何」的原因。

items.en: In the twentieth century the word became the name of a style that reduced images to exact figures. First date uncertain: the label spread through criticism rather than through a single coining.
items.cn: 二十世纪时这个词成了一派把形象简化为精确图形的风格之名。首见年代不确定：这个标签经评论界扩散，而非出自某一次命名。

note.en: Group one separates the adjective from near forms; group two separates words for regular arrangement.
note.cn: 第一组辨析这个形容词与邻近形式；第二组辨析表示规则排布的词。

entries.definition: The branch itself; the adjective differs from it by its ending, which is easy to lose in a fast scan.
entries.definitionCN: 指分支本身；形容词与它只差词尾，快速扫读时容易漏看。

entries.definition: A longer form of the same adjective, common in older writing; modern usage prefers the shorter one before nouns.
entries.definitionCN: 同一形容词的较长形式，多见于较早写作；现代用法在名词前多用较短者。

entries.definition: A specialist in the branch; the ending marks a person rather than a quality.
entries.definitionCN: 指该分支的专家；词尾标出人而非性质。

entries.definition: The same word also describes a constant ratio, a sense that surprises readers who know only the shape sense.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个词也描述固定比值，这一义项会让只知道形状义的读者意外。

entries.definition: Describes balance about an axis; a geometric pattern may be symmetrical, but symmetry is not required.
entries.definitionCN: 描述关于某轴的平衡；几何图案可以对称，但对称并非必要条件。

entries.definition: Describes things full of angles or sharp corners, without implying exact figures.
entries.definitionCN: 描述多角或尖角之物，并不暗示精确图形。

entries.definition: Describes a fixed relationship between quantities; a geometric progression is one kind of proportional change.
entries.definitionCN: 描述量之间的固定关系；等比变化是比例变化的一种。

entries.definition: Describes growth by a constant multiplying factor; it is the modern technical term where geometric is the older one.
entries.definitionCN: 描述按固定倍数增长；这是现代技术术语，而几何一词是较早的说法。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The adjective is the branch name plus a suffix of belonging, so it marks whatever can be described in figures.
normal.cn: 这个形容词是分支名加表示归属的后缀，因此标记可用图形描述的一切。

normal.en: Its oldest technical phrases are pattern, shape, progression and mean.
normal.cn: 它最老的技术搭配是图案、图形、数列与平均。

normal.en: A geometric progression multiplies, an arithmetic one adds: the difference is the operation between terms.
normal.cn: 等比数列做乘法，等差数列做加法：差别就在相邻项之间的运算。

normal.en: The family runs geometry, geometric, geometrical, geometrically, geometer.
normal.cn: 同族词包括几何、几何的、较长形容词、在几何上、几何学家。

normal.en: In art the word became a label: exact figures instead of curves and likenesses.
normal.cn: 在艺术中这个词成了标签：用精确图形取代曲线与肖似。

abstract.en: Picture a tile repeating a smaller copy of itself, four times over.
abstract.cn: 想象一块砖把自身的缩小复制一遍，如此重复四次。

abstract.en: Picture a drawing that refuses every wobble, as if a ruler were holding the pen.
abstract.cn: 想象一幅画拒绝任何抖动，仿佛有一把尺在管着笔。

abstract.en: Picture a staircase whose every step is exactly twice the height of the one before.
abstract.cn: 想象一道楼梯，每一级的高度正好是前一级的两倍。

examples.en: The garden was laid out in a geometric pattern of circles and squares.
examples.cn: 花园按圆与方的几何图案布置。

examples.en: Population grew geometrically for three decades.
examples.cn: 人口以几何速度增长了三十年。

examples.en: The artist moved from portraits to pure geometric forms.
examples.cn: 这位艺术家从肖像转向纯几何形式。

dict_mnemonic.text: 记作「量地的」：分支名加表示归属的尾巴 → 几何的、规则的

root: 希腊 geōmetrikos「丈量土地的、精于几何的」= ge「土地」+ metron「量度」+ 表示归属的后缀；拉丁 geometricus 与名词一并入学校；希腊用法已含比例义，故等比数列也称几何；二十世纪又成为几何抽象艺术之名。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses fan out from one adjective: belonging to the branch, built from exact shapes, changing by a fixed ratio, computed by multiplication, strictly linear in design, naming an art movement, exactly measurable in space, and as forced as a construction.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从一个形容词扇开：属于该分支、由精确图形构成、按固定比值变化、以乘法计算、设计上严格使用直线、命名一个艺术流派、在空间上可精确测量，以及像作图一样步步被迫。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: tiles nested inside tiles, each layer an exact enlargement of the one before.
core.cn: 核心意象：砖块层层套叠，每一层都是上一层的精确放大。

branches.en: The branch and its measurement: a proof about triangles, and a motion reduced to coordinates.
branches.cn: 分支与测量：关于三角形的证明，与化为坐标的运动。

branches.en: Figures in space and on a façade: the same exactness applied to pattern and to design.
branches.cn: 空间中与墙面上的图形：同一种精确性用于图案与设计。

branches.en: Ratio and multiplying mean: the older proportional sense that makes a progression geometric.
branches.cn: 比值与相乘的平均：使数列可称几何的较旧比例义。

branches.en: The movement: exact figures became a style and then a label.
branches.cn: 流派：精确图形成了风格，再成标签。

branches.en: The forced step: each line follows from the previous one with no approximation allowed.
branches.cn: 被迫的一步：每条线都由前一条逼出，不容近似。

intro.en: The adjective keeps the two Greek nouns of its parent and adds a suffix of belonging, so it reads as the branch name turned into a modifier.
intro.cn: 这个形容词保留了母词的两个希腊名词并加上表示归属的后缀，因此读起来是分支名转成的修饰语。

latinIntro.en: Ge and metron supply the meaning, -ikos makes the adjective, and Latin -icus carried it into English.
latinIntro.cn: 土地与量度两个词提供意义，希腊后缀构成形容词，拉丁词尾把它带入英语。

items.example: The first element keeps the measuring tied to land.
items.exampleCN: 第一个成分把测量系在土地上。

items.example: The second element supplies measuring and, later, ratio.
items.exampleCN: 第二个成分提供测量，后来也提供比值。

items.example: The suffix turns the compound into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把复合词变成形容词。

items.example: The Greek adjective already covered both shape and ratio.
items.exampleCN: 这个希腊形容词已兼指形状与比值。

items.meaning: of geometry; in a fixed ratio
items.example: English keeps both the shape and the ratio senses.
items.exampleCN: 英语同时保留形状义与比值义。

items.example: Older writing preferred the longer adjective.
items.exampleCN: 较早写作偏爱较长的形容词。

items.example: The adverb marks the terms of description.
items.exampleCN: 副词标记描述所用的方式。

items.example: The person suffix closes the family.
items.exampleCN: 表人后缀收拢词族。

items.meaning: a mean found by multiplying and taking a root
items.meaningCN: 相乘再开方所得的平均
items.example: The phrase records the ratio sense in technical form.
items.exampleCN: 这个短语以技术形式记录了比值义。

definition_zh: 三角学；三角计算；（某对象的）三角关系
definition_en: the branch of mathematics that deals with the relations between the sides and angles of triangles and with the functions derived from them
core_image: 一张测量图上，一条斜边与地面夹角被标出，旁边的影长被用来推算塔高
scene: 测量图上画着一座塔与它的影子，斜边与地面的夹角被标出，影长写在旁边。By trigonometry the surveyors found the height of the tower without climbing it.
sceneCN: 这里 trigonometry 指「用三角形的边角关系进行推算的三角学」（第 1 个义项：三角学）；句意为测量员用三角学不必爬塔就算出了塔高。图中可辨识物件：塔、影子、夹角标记、影长数字。

pos.zh: 三角学；三角计算；三角关系

senses.title: The branch about triangles
senses.titleCN: 研究三角形边角关系的三角学
senses.definition: the branch of mathematics that relates the sides and angles of triangles
senses.definitionCN: 研究三角形边与角之间关系的数学分支
senses.example: By trigonometry the surveyors found the height of the tower without climbing it.
senses.exampleCN: 测量员用三角学不必爬塔就算出了塔高。
senses.why: The name states its object and its method: three angles, measured.
senses.whyCN: 名称本身就说明了对象与方法：三个角，加以量度。

senses.title: The school or university course
senses.definition: the course in which the ratios of sides and the functions are taught
senses.definitionCN: 教授边之比与相关函数的课程
senses.example: Trigonometry comes right after geometry in the syllabus.
senses.exampleCN: 在课程安排里，三角学紧接在几何之后。
senses.why: A branch taught in sequence becomes a course, and the word covers the timetable as well as the field.
senses.whyCN: 一门按顺序教授的学问成为课程，这个词既指领域也指课表。

senses.title: Working out sides and angles
senses.titleCN: 求边与角的实际三角计算
senses.definition: the calculation of unknown sides or angles from known ratios
senses.definitionCN: 由已知比值算出未知边或角的运算
senses.example: He used trigonometry to check whether the wall was square.
senses.exampleCN: 他用三角计算核对那面墙是否方正。
senses.why: Here the word names the sums done on paper, not the science of such sums.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词指纸上做的那些计算，而非关于计算的科学。

senses.title: The triangular relations in a system
senses.titleCN: 某一系统内的三角关系
senses.definition: the set of angular and proportional relations that govern a particular physical situation
senses.definitionCN: 支配某一具体物理情境的角度与比例关系
senses.example: The trigonometry of the wave decides where the crests will meet.
senses.exampleCN: 这列波的三角关系决定了波峰会在哪里相遇。
senses.why: Any situation built on angles has a trigonometry of its own, and the phrase names that structure.
senses.whyCN: 任何建立在角度上的情境都有自己的三角关系，这个说法指那套结构。

senses.title: Plane and spherical branches
senses.definition: the two main divisions, one for flat figures and one for figures on a sphere
senses.definitionCN: 两大分科，一为平面图形，一为球面图形
senses.example: Navigators needed spherical trigonometry long before planes were formalised.
senses.exampleCN: 在平面三角被形式化之前很久，航海者就需要球面三角。
senses.why: Once the surface is curved, the old ratios no longer hold, so the branch splits into named parts.
senses.whyCN: 一旦表面弯曲，旧的比例不再成立，于是分支分成有名字的部分。

senses.title: The system of circular functions
senses.definition: the body of sine, cosine and tangent functions and their identities
senses.definitionCN: 正弦、余弦、正切等函数及其恒等式的整体
senses.example: Trigonometry turns a rotating arm into a pair of smooth waves.
senses.exampleCN: 三角学把一条旋转的臂变成一对平滑的波。
senses.why: The branch outgrew triangles: its functions now describe any periodic change.
senses.whyCN: 这门学问长出了三角形之外：它的函数如今描述任何周期性变化。

senses.title: The old art of celestial measurement
senses.titleCN: 古代天文测量中的三角术
senses.definition: in its early history, the ratios used to measure distances to the stars
senses.definitionCN: 在其早期历史中，用于测量到星辰距离的那些比值
senses.example: Ancient trigonometry grew from the wish to measure the sky.
senses.exampleCN: 古代三角术源于丈量天空的愿望。
senses.why: The first users were astronomers, and the ratios were tools for a distance no rope could reach.
senses.whyCN: 最早的使用者是天文学家，那些比值是够不到的距离的工具。

senses.title: Angles turned into distances
senses.titleCN: 把角度换算成距离的做法
senses.definition: the practical move of converting an observed angle into a measurable length
senses.definitionCN: 把观测到的角度换算成可量长度的实用做法
senses.example: Every map made by ranging relies on the same trigonometry.
senses.exampleCN: 每一张靠测距制成的地图都依赖同一套三角换算。
senses.why: The branch's working core is a single trick: one angle plus one known length yields every other length.
senses.whyCN: 这门学问的工作核心只有一个诀窍：一个角加一条已知边，就能得到其余各边。

intro.en: The word is a Latin compound of two Greek nouns, 'triangle' and 'measure', coined in the sixteenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个词是拉丁语中用两个希腊名词「三角形」与「量度」构成的复合词，十六世纪造出。年代均为约数。

items.en: Trigonon 'triangle' joined tri- 'three' to gōnia 'angle, corner'. The origin of gōnia before Greek is reconstructed, not attested.
items.cn: trigonon「三角形」由表示「三」的前缀与表示「角、隅」的词合成。表示角的词在希腊语之前的来源属重构形式，并无实证。

items.en: Metron 'measure' supplied the second half, the same element that stands in geometry and metre.
items.cn: metron「量度」提供后半部分，与几何、韵律诸词中所用的是同一成分。

items.en: A sixteenth-century mathematician formed the Latin title Trigonometria for a treatise on the solution of triangles, and the compound was Greek in its parts but Latin in its making.
items.cn: 一位十六世纪数学家用拉丁书名「三角测量」作为一部解三角形论著的标题；这个复合词部件是希腊的，造词却是拉丁的。

items.en: The first trigonometry was a set of tables for astronomy and navigation, computed before the functions were given modern symbols.
items.cn: 最早的三角学是一套供天文与航海用的表，在函数获得现代符号之前就已算好。

items.en: English borrowed the word in the seventeenth century and kept both the table-work and the theoretical senses.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪借入这个词，同时保留了查表计算与理论两层意思。

items.en: The functions later became the standard tools for any periodic process, far beyond triangles. First date uncertain: the extension into general wave analysis has no single recorded first year.
items.cn: 这些函数后来成为描述任何周期过程的标准工具，远远超出三角形。首见年代不确定：向一般波动分析的扩展没有单一可考的最早年份。

note.en: Group one separates words built on the same 'three' or 'angle' pieces; group two separates the neighbouring measuring arts.
note.cn: 第一组辨析同用「三」或「角」部件的词；第二组辨析相邻的测量技艺。

entries.definition: Shares the measuring element but not the triangle: it begins from land, not from three angles.
entries.definitionCN: 共用表示量度的成分，但不含三角形：它从土地出发，而非从三个角出发。

entries.definition: The adjective of the branch; it differs from the noun only by its ending.
entries.definitionCN: 这门分支的形容词；与名词只差词尾。

entries.definition: A rare word for a triangle, built from the same first element without the measuring half.
entries.definitionCN: 指三角形的罕用词，只有第一个成分而缺表示量度的后半。

entries.definition: A rare word for a quadrilateral, with the same angle element but a prefix meaning four.
entries.definitionCN: 指四边形的罕用词，角部相同，前缀表示四。

entries.definition: Studies all figures and their proofs; trigonometry is the part that turns angles into ratios.
entries.definitionCN: 研究一切图形及其证明；三角学是其中把角化为比值的那一部分。

entries.definition: The practical measuring of land and heights; it uses trigonometry but is a craft, not a science.
entries.definitionCN: 实地测量土地与高度；它使用三角学，但属于技艺而非科学。

entries.definition: The art of fixing a position and steering a course; trigonometry is one of its calculating tools.
entries.definitionCN: 确定位置与操舵的技艺；三角学是它的计算工具之一。

entries.definition: The study of celestial bodies, which first drove the building of trigonometric tables.
entries.definitionCN: 研究天体的学问，正是它最早推动了三角表的编制。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The name says exactly what it is: three angles, measured.
normal.cn: 名称把内容说得明明白白：三个角，加以量度。

normal.en: Its working trick is one known length plus one observed angle, yielding every other length.
normal.cn: 它的工作诀窍是一条已知边加一个观测角，就能得出其余各边。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the divisions: plane trigonometry, spherical trigonometry, a course in trigonometry.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出分科：平面三角、球面三角、三角学课程。

normal.en: The family runs trigonometry, trigonometric, trigonometrically, and the rare trigon for the figure itself.
normal.cn: 同族词包括三角学、三角的、用三角方法，以及指图形本身的罕用词。

normal.en: Astronomers were the first customers: the ratios were built to reach distances no rope could measure.
normal.cn: 天文学家是最早的主顾：这些比值是为够到绳索量不到的距离而造的。

abstract.en: Picture a tower and its shadow forming one right angle on the ground.
abstract.cn: 想象一座塔与它的影子在地面上构成一个直角。

abstract.en: Picture a rotating arm whose height and sideways reach trace two smooth waves.
abstract.cn: 想象一条旋转的臂，其高度与横向伸出各画出一条平滑的波。

abstract.en: Picture a sailor who knows one side of a triangle and reads the rest off a table by lamplight.
abstract.cn: 想象一位水手，知道三角形的一条边，就着灯光从表上读出其余各边。

examples.en: Trigonometry is used to measure heights that cannot be reached.
examples.cn: 三角学用来测量够不到的高度。

examples.en: The course covers trigonometry before calculus.
examples.cn: 这门课先讲三角学，再讲微积分。

examples.en: Spherical trigonometry was essential to early ocean navigation.
examples.cn: 球面三角对早期远洋航行至关重要。

dict_mnemonic.text: 记作「三个角 + 量度」：希腊语三角形加量度 → 三角学

root: 拉丁 trigonometria 为十六世纪新造，部件来自希腊语：trigonon「三角形」= tri-「三」+ gōnia「角」，再加 metron「量度」；起初是为天文与航海编制的三角表，后扩展为一般周期过程的工具。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one trick, turning an angle into a length: the branch, its course, the actual sums, the triangular relations inside a system, its plane and spherical divisions, the circular functions, the old astronomy, and the bare conversion of angle to distance.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个诀窍展开，即把角换成边长：分支、课程、实际计算、系统内部的三角关系、平面与球面两个分科、圆函数体系、古代天文术，以及把角换算成距离这一最朴素的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tower, its shadow, and one angle marked between them.
core.cn: 核心意象：一座塔、它的影子，以及两者之间标出的一个角。

branches.en: The branch and its hour: the same ratios, once as a science and once as a timetable slot.
branches.cn: 分支与课时：同一套比值，一次作为学问，一次作为课表上的一格。

branches.en: The working core: an observed angle plus a known length yields every other length.
branches.cn: 工作核心：一个观测角加一条已知边，得出其余各边。

branches.en: Structures and the sky: relations inside a wave, and the old ratios that reached the stars.
branches.cn: 结构与天空：波内部的关系，以及够到星辰的古老比值。

branches.en: The curved case: on a sphere the old ratios fail, so the branch splits.
branches.cn: 弯曲的情形：在球面上旧比值失效，分支于是分开。

branches.en: The rotating arm: triangles left behind, the functions describe any cycle.
branches.cn: 旋转的臂：三角形被留在身后，函数描述任何周期。

intro.en: The word is a Latin-made compound of Greek parts, so its morphemes are Greek while its assembly is European.
intro.cn: 这个词是拉丁语用希腊部件造成的复合词，因此语素是希腊的，组装方式是欧洲的。

latinIntro.en: Greek trigonon 'triangle' and metron 'measure' supply the two halves; Latin joined them, and English borrowed the result whole.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语表示三角形的词与表示量度的词提供两半；拉丁语把它们接起来，英语整体借入。

items.example: The prefix counts the angles the branch began with.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀数出这门分支起初研究的角。

items.example: The angle element names the thing measured.
items.exampleCN: 角的成分命名被量的对象。

items.example: The compound noun supplies the first half of the word.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合名词提供词的前半。

items.example: The second half supplies the measuring.
items.exampleCN: 后半提供量度。

items.example: The suffix makes the compound a name for a skill.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀使复合词成为技艺之名。

items.structure: New Latin, coined in the sixteenth century
items.example: Latin assembled the two Greek nouns into a title.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语把两个希腊名词组装成一个标题。

items.example: English keeps the whole borrowed compound.
items.exampleCN: 英语保留了整个借来的复合词。

items.example: The adjective marks ratios, functions and surveys.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词修饰比值、函数与测量。

items.example: The adverb marks the method of calculation.
items.exampleCN: 副词标记计算方法。
